Definition: diminutive from a derivative of the base of G5597; a crumb or morsel (as if rubbed off), i.e. a mouthful:--sop.
BiblicalUsage: Psomion means a sop, a morsel, a mouthful dipped and given. At the last supper, Jesus said, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it, and when He had dipped the sop, He gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon. And after the sop Satan entered into him, and then Judas, having received the sop, went immediately out, and it was night.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sop is the saddest morsel in the Bible: the Lord's own hand gave it, and the hand that took it went straight out into the night.
